builds.name: Five-second Poison Trail ceiling
builds.summary: Seek the highest damage from Five-second Poison Trail within the finite benchmark; candidate, not proof of a mathematical maximum.
builds.goal: Seek the highest damage from Five-second Poison Trail within the finite benchmark; candidate, not proof of a mathematical maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Q5 deals60+0.425AP per second. R3 adds85AP; five seconds exposure reward AP/magic amplification. Deathcap multiplies AP; Zhonya adds105AP; Riftmaker adds bonusHP-to-AP and8% full-ramp damage. Void/Shadowflame penetrate MR and amplify eligible low-health hits. Nearby Abyssal makes target take12% more magic damage. 30min Gathering Storm adaptive stats fixed; Absolute Focus requires ownerabove70%HP. First Strike ready but separate proc reported outside target packet; compare inactive.

Poison refreshes extend duration rather than stack trails; runtime ticks observed, no unlimited toggle. tradeoffs: Six final items explicitly replace late-game boots; slower access/escape, extreme cost and setup dependence. Raw-number candidate sacrifices practical positioning and does not prove a global maximum.
Confidence: plausible. This is a finite-condition ceiling candidate, not a solver-certified global maximum or a recommended match build.
buyOrder: This is a late six-item ceiling loadout. Compare individual item swaps at fixed level, earned stacks and target conditions; the displayed order is not a lane shopping order.
Keep boots and role starters during the actual game. A damage-slot boot replacement requires a deliberate late benchmark and may make the ability impossible to land.

builds.name: Fling: AP plus max-health throw
builds.summary: Explore a high Fling champion damage result with finite setup and controlled one-item swaps. This is an experiment, not a certified optimum.
builds.goal: Explore a high Fling champion damage result with finite setup and controlled one-item swaps. This is an experiment, not a certified optimum.
builds.hypothesis: Rank-5 E is 90 + 0.55 AP + 8% enemy max HP magic damage. AP improves the flat term; MR penetration affects both. Rank-3 Insanity Potion can add 85 AP if actually cast and recorded. The poison trail and adhesive root are separate effects, not extra fling multipliers.

ceiling.finiteState: Level 18, maximum selected rank unless overridden, game minute 30. Enemy champion: 3000 max HP, 100 armor, 50 MR; no allied buffs, dragons or elixirs. Owner full HP. No unearned permanent stacks. Read actual AD/AP/HP and resists before the hit. Item/rune proc damage is separate; no scoring after target death. One Fling; R active with actual AP read back. No poison ticks or item burn in the scored packet. Riftmaker pre-ramped from separate champion combat. Target starts at 30% HP; prior champion combat 4s. Gathering Storm fixed at minute 30; Absolute Focus only above 70% owner HP.

kitEvidence.formula:
Singed flings an enemy over his shoulder, dealing [50 / 60 / 70 / 80 / 90 + (0.55) × AP] plus [6 / 6.5 / 7 / 7.5 / 8]% max Health magic damage.

If Singed flings a target into his {{Spell_MegaAdhesive_Name}}, they are Rooted for [1 / 1.25 / 1.5 / 1.75 / 2] seconds.
